newsitem.title: ITALY: Two AT&T European executives set to depart.
newsitem.headline: Two AT&T European executives set to depart.

text.p: Two leading European executives with U.S. telecoms giant AT&T are due to resign this month, a spokesman for the company confirmed on Tuesday.

He said Mario Bonzano, the AT&T Corp unit's Milan-based president for Europe, the Middle East and Africa, and also Sergio Giacoletto the Geneva-based president of AT&T's international business unit will be leaving in February.
Both are leaving for personal reasons, and the announcements was made internally for Giacoletto late last year and for Bonzano last week.
The spokesman expected the company to announce a replacement for Bonzano shortly, while Merrill Tutton head of AT&T's UK operation will temporarily fill Bonsano's role.

The European edition of the Wall Street Journal said that the two departures are the latest in a string of executive departures in the past five months reflecting AT&T troubles in Europe as it struggles to define its European strategy.
